note: Re-judged 2026-10-24 (independent auditor, after 8a340e018a). RFC 7606 Section 3 (j): "If this is not possible, the procedures of [RFC4271] and/or [RFC4760] continue to apply, meaning that the "session reset" approach (or the "AFI/SAFI disable" approach) MUST be followed." The only changed unit is TestRFC7606MPUnreachTooShort, which gained a second tag line (RFC7606-5.3-6); its RFC7606-3.j-1 claim and its body are unchanged: an MP_UNREACH of length 2 (AFI only, no SAFI, so the attribute cannot be parsed) through ValidateUpdateRFC7606 must give exact RFC7606ActionSessionReset with AttrCode 15. The remaining negatives (MP_REACH length 4, NLRI overrun, IPv4 /33, IPv6 /129, all exact SessionReset), the parseable IPv4 and IPv6 positives, TestEnforceRFC7606_InvalidTrailingNLRI and the wire-level rfc7606-reset.ci (exact 3/9 NOTIFICATION for an unparseable MP_REACH, with a discrimination record) are unchanged. Ze implements the session-reset alternative, which satisfies the MUST. Verdict stands.
